anti_leakage_rules: Use chronological splits based on target timestamp
Fit every scaler on Train only
Exclude unavailable future features and future targets from model inputs
Keep Test isolated from feature, hyperparameter and checkpoint selection
Inverse-transform predictions before reporting metrics in Wh
attention_rules: Attention is extracted from the final locked trained Transformer
Attention describes model behavior and is not causal evidence
Attention analysis includes heads, last query, error conditions, spikes and seed stability
definition_of_done: Raw UCI data is validated without mutation
Feature engineering, scaling and windows are leakage-safe
Persistence, LSTM and Transformer are evaluated fairly
All registered controlled sweeps are completed
Rolling-origin robustness precedes final model lock
Final LSTM and Transformer use seeds 42, 123 and 2026
Untouched Test is evaluated once after lock
MAE, RMSE and R2 are reported in original Wh
Residual, regime, worst-error and attention analyses use executed results
Conclusions answer RQ1 through RQ7 without causal overclaiming
fair_comparison_rules: LSTM and Transformer share horizon, feature set, lookback, target and split
LSTM and Transformer share window protocol, scalers, samples and metrics
Checkpoint selection uses Validation RMSE for both model families
Architecture-specific parameters may differ only through approved validation tuning
protocol_violations: Random temporal split or shuffled windows before split
Test used for tuning or selection
Unfair data protocol between LSTM and Transformer
Scaled metrics reported as original Wh
Attention extracted from a model other than the final locked Transformer

research_questions.text: Can a Transformer Encoder learn useful multivariate temporal dependencies for short-term appliance-energy forecasting?
Does the Transformer outperform the LSTM under the same data and evaluation protocol?
Does additional Transformer complexity improve generalization or increase overfitting risk?
Which temporal patterns are visible in Transformer self-attention maps?
Does historical Appliances input improve forecasting over exogenous-only input?
Which approved 6-hour, 12-hour or 24-hour lookback is most suitable by validation evidence?
Which approved regularization strategies improve future-validation generalization?

test_policy: Test remains untouched until all configurations and final seeds are locked
No model or protocol change is permitted after viewing Test results
Any post-Test change is recorded as a protocol violation
validation_policy: Validation selects checkpoints and approved options by RMSE
Rolling-origin robustness is evaluated before final model lock
Validation is not reported as an unbiased final estimate
